name: Milagro
summary: Historical wide-field water-Cherenkov gamma-ray observatory that searched for dark matter, including neutralino annihilation near the Sun.
detection_principle: Photomultipliers in a large water pond record Cherenkov light from shower particles; directions and fluxes test possible solar-associated gamma-ray signals.

results.summary: Solar-direction searches tested specific neutralino scenarios.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
